★ Request
Pokke turns sharply toward the camera (front)
GRAAAAH!

First off, a clean break from Jungle Pocket,
slipping smoothly into a prime position!
After her commanding race, the other trainers are starting to take notice of Jungle Pocket. Before someone else beats me to it, I need to—

—! Bib number five... Oh, so you're the crowd favorite.
Heard you're pretty tough, Tsuzuki Reigning.

Hmm... Jungle Pocket, I never imagined she had that in her.
Explosive power, yet perfectly composed in her race execution... Most impressive...

Ha, hell yeah!
But... the real fight starts NOWWW!!

My plan to scout her in a suave, cool manner fell completely to pieces...
Even so, knowing she trusts me without hesitation makes me happier than words can say.

400 meters to go, and they're neck and neck! Jungle Pocket surges forward!
And closing fast from the outside, Tsuzuki Reigning unleashes a ferocious late charge!

I see, I see... Well, do keep at it.
And be sure to provide me with plenty of interesting data. I'll be looking forward to it.

Tomorrow is finally the Debut Selection Race. The lineup is stacked with talent...
There are even a few girls with higher expectations on them than Jungle Pocket.

I raise my voice and step between the two of them.
Now is my moment to step up as Jungle Pocket's trainer, bold and cool—

Yeah... this is awesome.
First, I'll smash the toughest rival right in front of me—and win!
So, that's the deal. Countin' on ya, partner!
The two of us are gonna crush you flat!!
Heh, perfect timing!

Whoa, unreal... Pokke-san's running keeps getting crazier and crazier...
She was already totally dominant back when she led the crew, but to think she's still got this much—
Classmates, hm? Fufu. By the way, have you actually finalized your contract with them?

I'll tell her that we should aim for the "strongest" together. I'm sure she'll nod firmly in agreement.
With that image in mind—for now, I watch her race.
—Pfft, so lame! Haha! Ahahaha!
Yeah... I can't wait.

You better keep polishing that "natural-born speed" of yours, too.
Don't you dare go losing before you face me.

Hahaha! Here we go, here we go, HERE WE GOOO!
I'M THE STRONGESTTTTTTTT!!

Just as I pumped myself up to scout her, she sprints straight off the track.
I have to chase after her...!

Same to you. Even if everyone else hasn't caught on yet, I know how strong you are.
Still... I'm not giving an inch.

Wha—!? She's still pulling away...!?
Why you...!

Nah, it's fine, it's fine. Sounds cheesy as hell, but...
Let's show 'em, then—the legend of the "Strongest"!
Ha, bring it on! That just makes crushing you all the sweeter!

What's with that lifeless reply?!
At times like this, you gotta rev it up and give it all you got!

...Ngh, you're better than I thought, Jungle Pocket...
But next time, I won't lose...!
Heheh. Now that's what I'm talkin' about, partner!

What is it, Pokke-kun? I'm rather busy, so make it quick. Oh, or perhaps
you're volunteering? I happen to have an experiment in need of a test subject—

She's right. Now that Jungle Pocket has accepted me as her partner,
I have to fire myself up too!
Don't you go looking down on me, treating me like a stepping stone.

Sorry to burst your bubble, but nope.
—I'm here to declare war, "classmate" Agnes Tachyon!

She slaps an arm around my shoulder with a grin,
leaving us standing side by side against Agnes Tachyon.

Just as expected, expectations around Jungle Pocket are fairly modest.
However... she is definitely going to win this race.
First race up—I'm gonna blow right past everyone, no contest.
—Hold it right there, Tachyon!!

Under an overcast sky, today's Debut Selection Race gets underway. Among this field of strong contenders,
the favorite is horse girl number five, a rising star with a formidable finishing kick!

She's through! Jungle Pocket breaks away!
Jungle Pocket crosses the finish line!!
—ALRIGHTTTT!!

Jungle Pocket is maintaining a firm grasp on her pacing.
She's holding a great position as she moves through the race—
1800 meters on turf—and they're off!

In the Twinkle Series, me and my partner are gonna win and win and keep on winnin'...
and then I'm blowin' right past you, too!
—Alright. I got this...!
